episodes.163753: A surface moisture boundary associated with the northern extension of a broad area of low pressure across the SE Gulf of Mexico was across South FL while a stationary front was across north/central FL. A few showers were able to develop off the coast of Palm Beach County along with a little bit of wind shear and relatively light winds. This spurred the development of a waterspout offshore Delray Beach in the Atlantic waters.
episodes.164185: Strong to severe thunderstorm moved across the northern Coastal Bend during the late afternoon producing wind gusts from 35 to 50 knots from Bayside to Rockport to Port Aransas.
